name: Ensure Plus Nutrition Shake (Vanilla)
whyItWorks: Concentrates 350 calories and 16g protein into a compact 8 fl oz serving. An indispensable tool during Crohn's or colitis flare recovery when rapid weight loss and nutrient malabsorption occur.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chill thoroughly. If rich sweetness causes nausea during a flare, split one bottle into two halves consumed 3 hours apart.
